description: This Java interface 'LoanAssembler' defines methods for constructing and updating 'Loan' objects within the loan management module of Apache Fineract, including methods for assembling loans from various identifiers and commands, as well as updating loan attributes during different lifecycle events.

classes.name: LoanAssembler
classes.description: An interface providing methods for assembling and updating Loan entities based on various identifiers and commands within the loan management process.

methods.name: assembleFrom(Long accountId)
methods.description: Constructs a Loan object using the account ID.

methods.name: assembleFrom(Long accountId, boolean loadLazyCollections)
methods.description: Constructs a Loan object with an option to load lazy collections.

methods.name: assembleFrom(ExternalId externalId)
methods.description: Constructs a Loan object from an external ID.

methods.name: assembleFrom(ExternalId externalId, boolean loadLazyCollections)
methods.description: Constructs a Loan object from an external ID with an option to load lazy collections.

methods.name: assembleFrom(JsonCommand command)
methods.description: Constructs a Loan object based on a JsonCommand input.

methods.name: accountNumberGeneration(JsonCommand command, Loan loan)
methods.description: Generates or assigns an account number to the provided Loan based on the command.

methods.name: findCodeValueByIdIfProvided(Long codeValueId)
methods.description: Retrieves a CodeValue entity if the ID is provided.

methods.name: findFundByIdIfProvided(Long fundId)
methods.description: Retrieves a Fund entity if the ID is provided.

methods.name: findLoanOfficerByIdIfProvided(Long loanOfficerId)
methods.description: Retrieves a Staff entity representing the loan officer if the ID is provided.

methods.name: updateFrom(JsonCommand command, Loan loan)
methods.description: Updates a Loan object based on data from a JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateLoanApplicationAttributesForWithdrawal(Loan loan, JsonCommand command, AppUser currentUser)
methods.description: Updates loan application attributes specifically for withdrawal scenarios.

methods.name: updateLoanApplicationAttributesForRejection(Loan loan, JsonCommand command, AppUser currentUser)
methods.description: Updates loan application attributes specifically for rejection scenarios.
